title: ReadingBatch
description: One message sent by a data concentrator every 30 minutes with the readings of several meters (F3).

message_id.description: Unique and stable id: concentrator + sequence. Consumers ignore a message_id they already stored.

is_resend.description: true when the message is resent in bulk after an outage.

interval_start.description: Start of the 30-minute interval. A skewed clock can move it off :00 or :30 (RN-01).

energy_kwh.description: Energy in the interval. Defects: null, the text "Null", negative values or peaks above 25 kWh.

reading_seq.description: Reading counter per concentrator. Between duplicates of the same meter and interval, the highest wins (RN-02).
